title: The Chew-Chew Potion
subtitle: I wish that the felt and pearls won't be soiled. I pray that a down pillow can bring sweet dreams like it always did.

trails.title: Trail ① Critters in the Forest
trails.description: You run into them on the way to the Scorched Woods.

items.text: The Chew-Chew Potion

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: *yawns* ... So sleepy ... The Chew-Chew Hallucinogen IX is almost there ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What on earth is missing ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oops!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Please mind your step and don't forget your manners, my lady. Ms. Sonetto is at work. Do not disturb her.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes. Sonetto received. We are on our way to the Relief Shelter, close to the woods.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Long story short. Our agents in Washington reported that all the relief supplies are being delivered to Chicago.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: What the Manus wants are those supplies. So you need to adjust your plan.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Our first priority is to stop them from grabbing the supplies and to rescue the refugees.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: There may well be a tough battle today. Just in case, we will send you some fresh crews.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Then what about the Timekeeper? She ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: She knows what she is doing.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You will meet when the mission is completed,  Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Understood. I will do my best.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Thank you for what you have done for the well-being of mankind. Looking forward to the good news.

items.speaker: THe letter from the Foundation
items.text: *shoot*

items.speaker: THe letter from the Foundation
items.text: An arrow dripping with slime pierces the letter.

items.speaker: Follower
items.text: Woods are locked! Go back if you're not transport staff!

items.speaker: Disciple
items.text: *roar*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Of course we are the transport staff, though the direction we're going is different from yours.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm? Now they arrived. I feel a lot more awake!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Everyone, please lend me your strength.
Although only half a day has passed, the woods are no longer the same as it was.
People sit around the base camp tent, stretchers, and temporary stoves, trying to smile in a pale face.
In the center, next to the huge crucible, there is a high wooden platform as required for a press conference with a Steinway piano.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: Hmm let me see, umm Mr. Forget Me Not. So you are the man who's gonna work with us?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Exactly.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: Show me your physician's license. Are you good at clinical diagnosis? How many patients have you seen?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Sir, I'm an arcanist.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: Oh, A.K.A con artist, right?

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I was invited. You've already prepared the crucible and materials I need, why bother asking me?

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: *tut* ... What are those numskull chiefs thinking!

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: ... What can this freak do? Playing house with some rotten roots and toad?

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: Isn't this Mr. Forget Me Not! Fabulous, such a relief that you're here ... *cough*

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: We haven't had any food for a whole night. We're starving, and can't stop thinking about eating ... I don't know. They say it's cash.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Don't worry, I promise everything will be ok, Mrs. Durant.

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: *cough* I know ... but you will definitely treat people in the white tent zone first, right?

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: For the love of all the great party times we had! We couldn't take any more of these.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: So ... there are other zones here.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Then ... who is living outside the white tent zone?

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: Only god knows. I heard that it's a bunch tramps and vendors, I've never seen them before!

items.speaker: Mrs. Durant
items.text: However, distinguished lady, you look very familiar. Have we met somewhere before?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I am afraid you made a mistake, madam.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The military officer gets angry as more and more people gather around here.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: Stop dawdling! Since you're here to save lives, hurry up then! Thousands of people are waiting!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Keep silent when I'm making potions, sir.

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: Yeah, pretentious ...

items.speaker: Commissioned Corps Officer
items.text: I'll check 30 mins later, to see what the hell you're up to!
You are in a good mood today.

branch.speaker: Forget Me Not
branch.text: I'm not interested in fruit cuts before the meal.

items.text: Why is he so rude?
items.edge_label: 他的态度为什么这么恶劣？

branch.speaker: Forget Me Not
branch.text: You're surprised? He is just another stupid human.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Enjoy the peace before "the Storm".
TO BE CONTINUED…
